text:
anya: PTAL — I pushed a follow-up that addresses the review comments from last week.

Changed: compact migration path + added a tiny rollback guard so we can flip the feature off quickly if needed. Split into two commits: `migration: compact path` and `ops: add rollback toggle`.

Files touched: `runtime/migration/compact.go`, `deploy/flags/feature_flags.go`, small test `runtime/migration/compact_test.go`.

What I validated locally: unit tests for compact path, basic e2e smoke that spins up 1 replica and runs the small sample workload. CI is queued. PTAL when you have a minute — mostly looking for a quick sanity check on the rollback logic and that the migration doesn't block startup. :hand:

mike: ack, will look in ~30m. can you paste the short command to run the smoke locally?

anya: sure — from repo root:```bash
make smoke-local && ./tools/smoke --config testdata/smoke/compact.yaml
```should be ~2-3m with local docker image.

ci-bot: CI started for anya/compact-migration (PR #4821) — running: unit, integration, lints.

sophia: quick question — does the rollback toggle default to false? we want safe-by-default. also any runtime config needed for Dedicated?

anya: yes default is `false`. docs comment added in `feature_flags.go`. Dedicated: no extra config, toggle reads from env var `REDWOOD_DISABLE_COMPACT_PATH` to short-circuit. I also added an annotation for ops to include on the Dedicated pool during rollout.

mike: skimmed code — small nit in `compact.go` around the metric label. otherwise looks fine. can you add a comment why the guard uses env var instead of config flag (ops wants quick flip via env/secret)?

anya: added comment and a one-line changelog entry in PR. pushed -> `a1b2c3d`.

ci-bot: unit tests passed. integration tests running (expected ~12m).

sophia: cool. can we schedule the merge to a quiet canary window tomorrow 09:30 PT? I'll coordinate with ops.

mike: I can be merge custodian if CI is green and you give the slot.

anya: thanks — that'd be great. ops pinged me, they said 09:30 PT ok. please wait for integration to finish and then merge.

ci-bot: integration tests passed. all checks green.

mike: merging now — will tag deploy-bot for canary.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for service: inference-runtime, release: `compact-migration-a1b2c3d`, start: 2026-03-19T09:30:00-07:00, mode: gradual.

sophia: thanks everyone. one follow-up: after canary, let's leave the rollback toggle in place for 72h then remove. note saved in the PR description. :+1:

anya: ack, will monitor logs and add an eval prompt set tomorrow morning. thanks for the quick eyes!
